grammar.numbers: the hook number fills the calendar's top page (percent/amount counts up; dates and years never do); a date stat flips through blank pages and lands on the date, circled in gold marker; every other figure is a gold sticky note stuck on the calendar's edge (the calendar shrinks aside for it)
grammar.comparisons: two tear-off calendar pages side by side, titles only from the cue's cards, values on the pages, gold marker ring on the highlight, gold arrow between, question underlined in highlighter
grammar.steps: to-do notepad slides up in front of the calendar: rows ticked in gold in spoken order, current row highlighted, unsaid rows empty checkboxes
grammar.change: old value on the calendar page (cue label in the navy header band); at swapAtMs the page tears off up over the binding and reveals the new value with an arrow chip from the data's direction and the old value struck; red/green only from the cue's tone
grammar.trend: week-planner spread: one column per point, gold marker line drawn through the values
grammar.banks: logo on white in a paper tab card top-left, neutral label
grammar.captionPosition: navy words on a white strip under the calendar, keywords under a gold highlighter; English line in slate on SAFE.bottom

skinAxes.cover: the wall calendar with the title on its first page, logo tile above
skinAxes.captions: bold navy on a clean white strip with a navy edge, gold highlighter keywords, unsaid words faint
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics, no footage: off-white desk with a planner dot grid
skinAxes.transitions: pages flip down, tear off, flip through; sticky notes slap on
skinAxes.texture: ruled paper, binder rings, page-stack edges, drifting lamp glow
skinAxes.sound: voice + page whoosh on tears and flip-throughs, ding on a landed date, clicks on ticks and compare pages
skinAxes.cta: white contact card + compliance card (classic outro)
